welcome.title: Echo
welcome.description: Your personal voice assistant. Allow microphone access, then speak naturally.
welcome.tip: Tip: make sure the Echo agent is running before connecting. Open Settings to add MCP connectors.

settings.title: Operator settings
settings.description: Model keys are configured on the agent server, never in the browser.
settings.byokHint: Switch to BYOK by setting MODEL_MODE=byok in agent/.env.local. See the project README.

mcp.title: MCP Connectors
mcp.description: Add HTTP/SSE MCP servers for this browser. Credentials stay in local storage for personal use only. Admin defaults on the agent still apply.
mcp.empty: No personal connectors yet. You can still use admin-configured MCP servers if set on the agent.

admin.title: Admin Panel
admin.subtitle: Configure API keys and integrations for Echo.
admin.loginPrompt: Enter the administrator password to continue.
admin.tavilyDescription: Enable Echo to search the web for current information using Tavily.
admin.apiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep existing key
admin.apiKeyHint: Get a free API key from tavily.com. Local saves go to agent/data/api_config.json.
admin.webSearchDescription: When disabled, Echo will not use Tavily even if a key is configured.
admin.mcpDescription: Admin-default MCP servers for every Echo session. Users can still add personal connectors in Settings.
admin.mcpHint: In production, set the agent secret MCP_SERVERS to a JSON array. Locally you can save to agent/data/mcp_servers.json.
admin.mcpInvalidJson: MCP JSON must be a valid array.
admin.productionDescription: This Vercel deployment cannot save keys to disk (read-only filesystem). Configure agent secrets instead: TAVILY_API_KEY, MCP_SERVERS.

history.pageSubtitle: Review your past voice conversations with Echo.
history.noSessionsHint: Your first chat session with Echo will appear here.
history.dbDisabled: History is not available right now.
history.dbDisabledHint: Make sure the agent is running with SQLite enabled, or configure AGENT_HISTORY_ENDPOINT / AGENT_DATA_DIR.
history.selectToView: Select a session on the left to view the transcript.
history.sessionMissing: Session not found or history unavailable.
history.emptyTranscript: No messages in this session yet.
